steps.title: Prepare 96‑well plates and pauses
steps.instruction: Set up two 96‑well plates with samples and required reagents; include a pause to refill tips if necessary and a pause to replace the plates on slots 1 and 4 with fresh plates.

steps.title: Add P3 buffer
steps.instruction: Add P3 buffer to the wells of the plates as indicated.

steps.title: Incubate samples (pause)
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol and take the samples for incubation.

steps.title: Transfer to plates 2 and 5
steps.instruction: Transfer each sample to plate 2 and plate 5.

steps.title: Add A1 buffer to second plates
steps.instruction: Add A1 buffer to the second set of plates (plates 2 and 5).

steps.title: Transfer back to plates 1 and 4
steps.instruction: Transfer the samples back to plate 1 and plate 4.

steps.title: Add AW2 buffer
steps.instruction: Add AW2 buffer to the samples.

steps.title: Add AE buffer
steps.instruction: Add AE buffer to the samples.
